questions.question: How is the suffering servant described in Isaiah 53?
options: Wealthy and greatly honored, served by very many nations
Mighty and greatly feared, a warrior crowned about with glory
Wise and much admired, sought out continually by many kings
Despised and rejected, a man of sorrows acquainted with grief
questions.answer: Despised and rejected, a man of sorrows acquainted with grief

questions.question: Why was the servant pierced and crushed, according to Isaiah 53?
options: For his own secret sins and pride
By a tragic and senseless accident
For the sake of his own very great glory

questions.question: Isaiah 53 says like a lamb led to the slaughter, he opened not his mouth.
He was pierced for our transgressions; he was crushed for our _____.
All we like _____ have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way.
